title: 2 mT NMR instrument: housing, probe and data models
blurb: Work in progress: housing, probe, B0 coil pair and a 3D-printable data model, designed and cross-checked in OpenSCAD, with laser and water-jet versions. Simulating the probe showed the field is fine (about 2 Hz over the sample) but the voltage-driven B0 coils warm up and walk the line 138 Hz a minute.
